name: Persist TimeSpace export registration

on:
  push:
    branches: [feature/trend-registration-time-space-export-receipt]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

jobs:
  persist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Enforce append-only registration history
        shell: bash
        env:
          PUSH_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          PUSH_AFTER: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          base_protection_validator="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-external-protection-validator.py"
          base_protection_config="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-external-protection.json"
          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:scripts/validate_time_space_external_protection.py" > "$base_protection_validator"
          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:config/research/time_space_export_external_protection_v1.json" > "$base_protection_config"
          python "$base_protection_validator" --config "$base_protection_config"
          base_validator="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-registration-push-validator.py"
          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:scripts/validate_time_space_registration_push.py" > "$base_validator"
          python "$base_validator" \
            --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --before "$PUSH_BEFORE" \
            --after "$PUSH_AFTER" \
            --phase persist \
            --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Validate durable registration evidence
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PUSH_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          checkpoint=$REGISTRATION_CHECKPOINT
          receipt=$REGISTRATION_RECEIPT
          trust=$REGISTRATION_TRUST
          export_file=$REGISTRATION_EXPORT
          provenance=$REGISTRATION_PROVENANCE
          repository="infdahai/zenQuant"
          checkpoint_run=$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["provider_run_id"])' "$trust")
          generator_run=$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["generator_provider_run_id"])' "$trust")
          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$checkpoint_run" > checkpoint-provider-run.json
          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$generator_run" > generator-provider-run.json
          base_validator="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-persisted-registration-validator.py"
          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:scripts/validate_time_space_persisted_registration.py" > "$base_validator"
          python "$base_validator" \
            --checkpoint "$checkpoint" \
            --receipt "$receipt" \
            --trust "$trust" \
            --export "$export_file" \
            --provenance "$provenance" \
            --provider-run-json checkpoint-provider-run.json \
            --generator-provider-run-json generator-provider-run.json
